front.title: SD-WAN Edge and Underlay Tunnel Discovery Using BGP

abstract.t: This document specifies BGP mechanisms for SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network) edge node attribute discovery. These mechanisms comprise a new tunnel type and associated Sub-TLVs for the BGP Tunnel Encapsulation Attribute, and a new Subsequent Address Family Identifier (SAFI) carrying a typed NLRI for advertising SD-WAN underlay tunnel information.
